# Token Spec 1.2.0

One shape for every measurement on Earth. What may change between versions (only additions) is in [`SPEC_POLICY.md`](../SPEC_POLICY.md).

## The slots

| Slot | Holds | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | observation · forcing · property · event · derived | What sort of thing it is. |
| `instrument` | a registered name | Says what the numbers in `value` mean. |
| `lat, lon` | WGS84 degrees; lon in [-180, 180) | Where. |
| `depth_km` | km below the WGS84 ellipsoid | Negative is above it: a station on a hill. |
| `time` | seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z | Proleptic Gregorian, ±4.6 billion years. |
| `time_iso` | ISO 8601, optional | The same moment for humans; must agree with `time`. |
| `value` | list of numbers | One per channel of the instrument. |
| `uncertainty` | list of numbers > 0 | 1σ per channel. Never zero. |
| `uncertainty_basis` | reported · derived · assumed | Where the uncertainty came from. |
| `location_uncertainty` | optional, 1σ | How well *where and when* are known. |
| `qualifiers` | text labels | Magnitude type, station code, intensity scale… |
| `provenance` | source, version, licence, hash… | Enough to fetch the same bytes again. |
| `resolution` | spatial_km, temporal_s | How big a patch of space and time one value covers. |

## Instruments

### `fluid_injection`

Fluid pumped into the ground through one well over a reporting period: the volume, placed at the well and the middle of its injection interval.

Kinds: `forcing` · added in 1.2.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `volume` | `m3` | 0 … 1e+09 | Volume injected during the period the resolution names. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `well` | yes | pattern `[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{1,64}` | The well's identifier at its regulator (a US API number, for one). |
| `well_class` | no | pattern `.{1,32}` | The regulator's class of the well (disposal, enhanced recovery, …), its own code. |
| `fluid` | no | pattern `.{1,64}` | What was injected, in the regulator's words. |
| `formation` | no | pattern `.{1,128}` | The formation the fluid goes into, in the regulator's words. |

References: Keranen et al. (2014), Science 345, 448-451, doi:10.1126/science.1255802; Langenbruch & Zoback (2016), Science Advances 2, e1601542

### `friction_coefficient`

How hard it is to slide one side of a fault over the other.

Kinds: `property` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `friction` | `1` | 0 … 2 | Coefficient of friction. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `friction_kind` | yes | `static`, `steady_state`, `dynamic` | Which friction. |
| `method` | no | pattern `.{1,64}` | How it was measured or inferred. |

### `gnss_daily`

One day of a GNSS station's position: east, north and up in metres, from the provider's daily solution, relative to the series origin named in its provenance.

Kinds: `observation` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `east` | `m` | -2.1e+07 … 2.1e+07 | Eastward position. |
| `north` | `m` | -2.1e+07 … 2.1e+07 | Northward position. |
| `up` | `m` | -12000 … 12000 | Vertical position. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `station` | yes | pattern `[A-Z0-9]{4}` | Four-character station code. |
| `reference_frame` | yes | `IGS14`, `IGS20`, `ITRF2014`, `ITRF2020`, `ETRF2000`, `ETRF2014`, `ETRF2020` | Frame the positions are expressed in. |

References: Blewitt, Hammond & Kreemer (2018), Eos 99, doi:10.1029/2018EO104623

### `grain_size`

Granularity: how coarse the grains of a rock or sediment are (median diameter).

Kinds: `property` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `log10_median_diameter` | `log10(mm)` | -5 … 4 | log10 of median grain size in mm. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | no | pattern `.{1,64}` | How it was measured or inferred. |

### `gutenberg_richter_b`

The b-value of a set of earthquakes: how fast the number of quakes falls as the magnitude rises. Computed from other tokens, so it is derived.

Kinds: `derived` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `b_value` | `1` | 0.1 … 4 | Gutenberg-Richter b-value. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | yes | `aki_utsu_mle`, `b_positive`, `least_squares` | Estimator. |
| `magnitude_type` | yes | `ML`, `Mw`, `Md`, `mb`, `mB`, `Ms`, `Mwp`, `MwL`, `Mwpd`, `Mc`, `Mmacro`, `M`, `Mj`, `Mh`, `mb_Lg`, `MLv` | Magnitude scale of the input events. |

References: Aki (1965); Utsu (1966); van der Elst (2021), b-positive

### `lithology`

What the rock is, as probabilities over the 13 rock classes of the Global Lithological Map. A certain answer is a one-hot vector; a geologist's 'probably limestone, maybe marl' is a spread.

Kinds: `property` · the channels are probabilities and sum to 1 · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unconsolidated_sediments` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is unconsolidated sediments. |
| `siliciclastic_sedimentary` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is siliciclastic sedimentary. |
| `mixed_sedimentary` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is mixed sedimentary. |
| `carbonate_sedimentary` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is carbonate sedimentary. |
| `pyroclastics` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is pyroclastics. |
| `evaporites` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is evaporites. |
| `metamorphics` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is metamorphics. |
| `acid_plutonic` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is acid plutonic. |
| `intermediate_plutonic` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is intermediate plutonic. |
| `basic_plutonic` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is basic plutonic. |
| `acid_volcanic` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is acid volcanic. |
| `intermediate_volcanic` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is intermediate volcanic. |
| `basic_volcanic` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Probability the rock is basic volcanic. |

References: Hartmann & Moosdorf (2012), G-cubed 13, doi:10.1029/2012GC004370

### `macroseismic_report`

What an earthquake did at one place, read from written accounts: chronicles, letters, questionnaires, damage surveys. The monk's diary lives here.

Kinds: `observation` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | `1` | 1 … 12 | Macroseismic intensity on the named scale. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scale` | yes | `MCS`, `EMS-98`, `MMI`, `MSK-64` | Intensity scale. |
| `place` | no | pattern `.{1,128}` | Locality name as the study gives it. |
| `event_id` | no | pattern `[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{1,128}` | The archive's ID for the earthquake. |
| `study` | no | pattern `[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{1,128}` | The study that assessed the intensity. |

References: ASMI, https://emidius.mi.ingv.it/ASMI/; Grünthal (1998), EMS-98

### `reservoir_pressure`

Pore-fluid pressure in a reservoir at a point and a moment, from a reservoir model matched to the pressures measured in its wells.

Kinds: `forcing` · added in 1.2.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pressure` | `MPa` | 0 … 300 | Pore-fluid pressure. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | yes | pattern `.{1,128}` | The reservoir model and its version. |
| `reservoir` | no | pattern `.{1,128}` | The reservoir or formation. |

References: Bourne & Oates (2017), JGR Solid Earth 122, 10299-10320, doi:10.1002/2017JB014356

### `rock_permeability`

How easily fluid flows through a rock. It spans twenty orders of magnitude, so the channel is its base-10 logarithm.

Kinds: `property` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `log10_permeability` | `log10(m2)` | -25 … -5 | log10 of permeability in m². |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | no | pattern `.{1,64}` | How it was measured or inferred. |

### `rock_porosity`

Fraction of a rock's volume that is empty space.

Kinds: `property` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `porosity` | `1` | 0 … 1 | Pore volume / total volume. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | no | pattern `.{1,64}` | How it was measured or inferred. |

### `rock_temperature`

Temperature of the rock at a point, from a borehole or a thermal model.

Kinds: `property` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `temperature` | `Cel` | -90 … 7000 | Temperature. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | no | pattern `.{1,64}` | How it was measured or inferred. |

### `seismic_catalog`

An earthquake from a seismic catalogue: where and when it began, and its size.

Kinds: `event` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `magnitude` | `1` | -3 … 10 | Magnitude on the scale named by magnitude_type. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `magnitude_type` | yes | `ML`, `Mw`, `Md`, `mb`, `mB`, `Ms`, `Mwp`, `MwL`, `Mwpd`, `Mc`, `Mmacro`, `M`, `Mj`, `Mh`, `mb_Lg`, `MLv` | Which magnitude scale. |
| `event_id` | no | pattern `[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{1,128}` | The catalogue's own ID for the event. |
| `event_type` | no | `earthquake`, `induced or triggered event`, `quarry blast`, `explosion` | QuakeML event type. |

References: QuakeML 1.2, https://quake.ethz.ch/quakeml

### `solid_earth_tide`

How far the Sun and the Moon stretch the solid Earth at a point: the body tide's displacement, computed from a tide model.

Kinds: `forcing` · added in 1.0.0

| Channel | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `east` | `m` | -1 … 1 | Eastward tidal displacement. |
| `north` | `m` | -1 … 1 | Northward tidal displacement. |
| `up` | `m` | -1 … 1 | Vertical tidal displacement. |

| Qualifier | Required | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | yes | `IERS2010` | Tide model. |

References: IERS Conventions (2010), Technical Note 36, chapter 7

## Units

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `1` | dimensionless (magnitudes, intensities, ratios, probabilities) |
| `m` | metre |
| `mm` | millimetre |
| `km` | kilometre |
| `s` | second |
| `Pa` | pascal |
| `kPa` | kilopascal |
| `MPa` | megapascal |
| `Cel` | degree Celsius |
| `K` | kelvin |
| `mm/a` | millimetres per year |
| `m3` | cubic metre |
| `log10(m2)` | base-10 logarithm of a permeability in square metres |
| `log10(mm)` | base-10 logarithm of a length in millimetres |

{
